accepted_examples.author: gerd
accepted_examples.content: Brannoc says he heard on the road that there has been fighting beyond the forest, but he did not see it himself. Rowena says the fighting is right at our gate, not the east road, which means the danger is closer than we thought. Verify these conflicting reports before acting. [!search]

accepted_examples.author: cilla
accepted_examples.content: Reports of fighting beyond the forest and raiders on the east road are conflicting. Assess the danger level before moving. If the fighting is at the edge of the trees, stay indoors. [!assess(ticks=6)]

accepted_examples.author: frida75
accepted_examples.content: The low road is washed out at the ford, cutting us off from the market. The river water is backing up into the lower fields. Do not attempt to travel the low road. Instead, assess the damage to the fields and determine if the water can be cleared before it ruins the crops. [!assess(ticks=6)]

wrong argument name.content: Alda says the low road ford is washed out so all trade takes the longer east road and prices will spike. There is a fair to be held beyond the forest, which you can check by looking at the road later. Do not attempt to cross the low road ford. If you need to travel to the fair, take the east road and be prepared for higher prices. [!avoid(site=low_road_ford)] [!go(site=east_road)]
wrong argument name.why: [!avoid] was given ['site'], which it does not read (it reads ['place', 'ticks'])

You hear that the lord's men are counting heads for a new tax, and the squeeze is tighter than before. Do not rest yet. Keep your guard up and watch the road for any stragglers or raiders who might take advantage of the dark. [!wander(ticks=10)] [!warn(topic=tax)]

names someone not in the village.content: The blight has driven grain prices up tenfold and the wolves are circling the herds. Check the fences at the high pastures and warn the elders if the stock is at risk. We must arm the fences before the first snow. [!warn(target=elders)]

names someone not in the village.author: cilla223

names someone not in the village.content: The levy has doubled, making the roads more dangerous for moving goods. If you must move stock or grain, do so only when the raiders are not at the front gate. Warn others that the raiders have smashed through the forest line and are fighting at the gate. [!warn(target=villagers, topic=raiders)]

names someone not in the village.author: odd215

names a place not in the village.content: A hard frost came early and took the fields. The grain is valuable and the market is distant. Do not waste time on unnecessary journeys. Focus on securing what remains and keeping the household warm and fed. [!work(site=house, ticks=12)]

names a place not in the village.author: per152

names a place not in the village.content: Wolves are gathering at the edge of the high pastures. Keep the flock close to the homestead to prevent them from taking ewes. Do not let the animals stray far from the watchful eye. [!work(site=pasture, ticks=10)]

no action marker.content: The low road ford is washed out and the sickness is spreading in the eastern valleys. Avoid the east road entirely. If you must move, go to the safe western paths and warn others of the blocked exits. [!avoid(road=east), !warn(topic=road_blocked)]
no action marker.author: hakon206

no action marker.content: The low road is washed out and the ford is gone, so all trade takes the longer east road. Since the lord's men are counting heads at the crossroads, expect new taxes. Do not attempt to travel the low road or the ford; it is impassable and dangerous. [!avoid(site=low_road), !avoid(site=ford)]
no action marker.author: alda84

a marker the village does not have.content: Grain prices have doubled and the hoard at Ashby mill is drawing raiders. If you are tasked with moving grain, do so only if the lord's men are not at the fences. If the raiders are regrouping beyond the forest, the roads are too dangerous. Wait for the night to pass or for the raiders to be pulled away. [!wait(ticks=12)] [!talk(site=village_square)]

a marker the village does not have.content: Grain prices have skyrocketed and the lord's men are taking supplies at the crossroads. Hide your stores and do not travel the east road unless you can pay double for safe passage. Seek out the healer if sickness is spreading in the neighboring valleys. [!hide(supplies=grain)] [!seek(site=healer)]

most_chosen.author: brit140
most_chosen.content: It is night and dark. Brit140 is at the watchpost. Do not leave your post to seek out Gunne131 or Hakon130; the darkness and the nearby fighting make it too risky to move. Rest only when the watch is relieved. [!rest(ticks=1)]

most_chosen.author: gunne60
most_chosen.content: It is night and dark, and the schoolyard is quiet. Gunne60 is at the schoolyard with Cilla68, Edek, Col64, and Mads62. Rest now, for the wolves are already inside the high pastures and the lord's men are counting heads. [!rest]

most_chosen.author: nils
most_chosen.content: The night is dark and the rain is falling. Nils is at the watchpost with Ivar, Jory, and the apprentices. Elspeth says there is fighting beyond the forest. Keep your guard up and watch the road for stragglers. [!work(site=watchpost, ticks=12)]

most_chosen.author: cilla
most_chosen.content: It is night and the village is dark, time to sleep. Cilla is out in the village with Gerd, Mabel, Osric, and Thea. A storm broke over the village and kept everyone indoors. Stay close to the group and keep watch. [!rest(ticks=12)]

most_chosen.author: lorne76
most_chosen.content: The night is dark and the rain is falling. Lorne76 is at the Wick & Kettle inn with Col, Elin45, Garrick, and Gerd46. Rest here until the storm passes and the roads are safe to travel. [!rest(ticks=12)]

most_chosen.author: runa111
most_chosen.content: It is night and dark, time to sleep. Runa111 is at the mill. Nearby are Gunne, Runa, and Ilsa. The stranger at the inn claims wolves are circling the high pastures and will take a ewe before the first frost. Rest at the mill until dawn; do not venture out into the dark. [!rest(ticks=12)]

most_chosen.author: bryn
most_chosen.content: It is night and dark, and the house is quiet. Bryn is at house 3 with no one nearby. It is time to sleep. [!rest(ticks=12)]

most_chosen.author: ivar
most_chosen.content: It is night and dark, and it is raining. Ivar is at the watchpost. Nearby are Per, an apprentice, Freya, an elder, and Ilsa, an adult. Do not engage in non-essential travel or socializing. Focus on maintaining the watch and listening for reports from Jory regarding Gisla's observations of fighting just past the treeline. [!rest(ticks=12)]

never_chosen_examples.author: kell
never_chosen_examples.content: It is night and dark, and the market is a place for the day. If you are at the market when the sun goes down, ensure you are with known adults or apprentices. Do not wander alone in the dark near the houses where children are sleeping. Rest or return to a safe location. [!rest(ticks=10)]

never_chosen_examples.author: inga
never_chosen_examples.content: It is night and dark, time to sleep. If you are at the shrine, rest there. Do not travel the high pastures or the low road after dark when the wolves are active. [!rest(ticks=12)]

never_chosen_examples.author: jory159
never_chosen_examples.content: Word travels that grain is so dear in the market towns that stealing a cartload brings a king's ransom. With the roads jammed and thieves bolder, you must assess the risk before moving. Look over the path and the people, and decide if the road is safe or if you must avoid it. [!assess(ticks=6)]
